# Ovini Wijesooriya

> Food Science & Technology undergraduate at the University of Peradeniya (Sri Lanka), emerging researcher, student leader and public speaker. Winner of the Alfred Baur Gold Medal for Most Outstanding Emerging Researcher at FAuRS 2026 (Faculty of Agriculture Research Symposium, University of Peradeniya).

Canonical site: https://ovini.me/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ovini-wijesooriya

## Key facts
- Education: BSc (Hons) in Food Science & Technology, University of Peradeniya (final year); Diploma in Information Technology, University of Colombo School of Computing (2023).
- FAuRS 2026 awards: Alfred Baur Gold Medal (Most Outstanding Emerging Researcher), Best Presenter, Winner of Scientific Eye Photography, 1st Runner-up in Research Briefs (Sinhala).
- Research: Development and evaluation of an ADDIE-based mobile health platform to improve dietary behaviour and cardiometabolic health among undergraduates of the University of Peradeniya.
- Project: MealBridge.lk, a real-time food redistribution platform with environmental impact tracking, to reduce food waste in Sri Lanka (https://mealbridge.lk).
- Other recognition: 2nd Runner-up, Best Green Innovation, Profood Propack AgBiz Exhibition 2025 (SLFPA); presenter at the 24th International Students' Summit, Bogor, Indonesia (2025).
- Leadership: Local Committee Vice President (AIESEC in Sri Lanka), Secretary of the Indeewari Sub-Committee (Agriculture Faculty Students' Union), Head of Journalism (Perabeats Media Society), Secretary of the Society of Food Science & Technology, and more.
- Industry: In-Plant Trainee, Quality Assurance at CIC Dairies (2026); In-Plant Trainee at Ma's Tropical Food Processing (2023).
- Skills: public speaking, event compering, project management, public relations, digital marketing, effective communication.
- Languages: English (fluent), Sinhala (native).
